sentences.text: A vessel constrained by her draft may show, in addition to her power-driven lights, three all-round red lights in a vertical line, or by day a cylinder.
Rule twenty-nine covers pilot vessels on pilotage duty.
She shows white over red all-round lights at or near the masthead.
When underway she adds sidelights and a sternlight.
At anchor she adds her anchor light or lights.
When a pilot vessel isn’t on pilotage duty, she shows the normal lights for a vessel of her length.
